panel.label: Safety
panel.name: safety
panel.text: VR safety and comfort (apply while Slipstream runs in a VR headset)

A frame rate below the headset's refresh rate can cause motion sickness. When frames are missed, Slipstream lowers draw distance and other costly settings until the frame rate recovers, then restores them. Your settings are not changed.

slider.label: Comfort vignette when moving:
slider.name: vr_vignette
slider.tool_tip: Darkens the edges of your view while it moves without your head (thumbstick walking, flying, the fly cam, vehicles, smooth turning). Reduces motion sickness. 0 = off.

check_box.label: Smooth turning (turning in steps is gentler for most people)
check_box.name: vr_smooth_turn
check_box.tool_tip: The right thumbstick turns you continuously instead of in steps. Smooth turning makes many people feel sick.

slider.label: Turn step (degrees):
slider.name: vr_snap_degrees
slider.tool_tip: How far one flick of the right thumbstick turns you.

slider.label: Smooth turning speed (degrees/s):
slider.name: vr_smooth_speed
slider.tool_tip: How fast smooth turning turns you at full stick.

check_box.label: The thumbsticks do not move me while the UI wall is shown
check_box.name: vr_wall_freeze
check_box.tool_tip: While the UI wall is up the sticks belong to the UI (walking around physically still works). Off: they move you as usual, except the pointing hand's stick while it points at the wall (it scrolls).

check_box.label: Teleport with the left thumbstick instead of walking
check_box.name: vr_teleport_move
check_box.tool_tip: Push the left thumbstick forward and hold to aim an arc at a landing spot (blue: you can go there, red: you can't), let it go to teleport there; pull it back to cancel. The right thumbstick still turns you and moves you up and down.

spinner.label: My standing eye height (m):
spinner.name: vr_eye_height
spinner.tool_tip: At this real height your view is at your avatar's eyes. Recenter takes your current height instead (to play seated: sit down, then recenter).

button.label: Recenter VR View
button.name: vr_recenter
button.tool_tip: What you face becomes your avatar's facing, and where your head is now becomes your avatar's eyes (also your height). The same as holding the left thumbstick down for a second.

combo_box.name: vr_view_height_mode
combo_box.tool_tip: Saved for each avatar. At the avatar's eyes: the view is where your avatar's eyes are (as in mouselook). At my own height: your real height above the avatar's feet, whatever the avatar's size. Scale the world to my avatar: at the avatar's eyes, with the world (distances, depth, your head's movement) scaled to the avatar, so a small avatar sees a big world.

combo_box.item.label: Scale the world to my avatar
combo_box.item.name: vr_view_height_scaled

slider.label: World size with this avatar:
slider.name: vr_world_scale
slider.tool_tip: Saved for each avatar. 1 = real size. Above 1 the world looks bigger (you are smaller); below 1 it looks smaller.
